q: How do I calculate emissions from a hotel's airport or guest shuttle?
title: Hotel guest shuttle emissions
short: If the hotel owns or leases the shuttle and employs the driver, its diesel is Scope 1 at 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. A shuttle supplied with driver by a travel vendor is Scope 3. Divide fuel by transfers to report per guest trip.
audience: Hotels and resorts running guest transfers

ul: Vendor vehicles with drivers, paid by the hotel: Scope 3, Category 1.
Taxis booked and paid by guests: outside the hotel's inventory.

p: Fuel invoices or fuel cards per vehicle, and the transfer log with trips and passengers.
Report per transfer, or per passenger if the log records them, and keep it apart from the room footprint.

example.title: Worked example: two hotel shuttles (one month, illustrative inputs)

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and fuel card statements (diesel 2.68 and CNG 2.69 kg CO2, IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 record. Hired transport goes to the Scope 3 evidence trail, and distance or tonne-km estimates are labelled as estimates.
